_README: Tool Kumar interface strings. Translate every value except keys that start with _ or end with ._context (those are notes for you). Keep {placeholders} exactly; you may move them. Keep Tool Kumar, JSON, file formats, language names, keyboard keys (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Esc, Enter, Tab, Space) and anything that is code untranslated. Plural keys end in .one/.other: provide one key per CLDR plural category of your language (for example ru: .one .few .many .other; fr/es/pt: .one .many .other; ja/ko/zh: .other only). UI labels must match the 'UI labels referenced in the text' table of your glossary. Keep labels short: buttons, tabs and menu items share small toolbars, also on phones. Check your file with: node /home/ubuntu/seo-ops/scripts/check-ui.mjs <locale>

home.intro: Tool Kumar is a free online JSON viewer, formatter and validator. Paste JSON or open a local file to format it, check syntax, repair common mistakes and inspect the result in a readable tree or table.
home.toolsH2: JSON tools that run in your browser
home.tools.1: Format and beautify JSON with readable indentation.
home.tools.validator: Validate JSON and jump to the exact line and column with an error, or use the dedicated <validator>JSON validator with line and column errors</validator>.
home.tools.validator._context: Text inside <validator>…</validator> links to the JSON validator page in your language; keep the tag pair.
home.tools.3: Repair comments, trailing commas, single quotes and other common input mistakes.
home.tools.4: Minify JSON, sort keys and copy a clean result.
home.tools.5: Explore nested objects in a collapsible tree or table view.
home.tools.6: Search keys and values, copy JSON paths, compare documents and convert JSON to other formats.
home.howH2: How to use the JSON viewer
home.how.1: Paste JSON into the input pane or choose a JSON file from your device.
home.how.2: Read the formatted output, expand the tree or switch to the table view.
home.how.3: Fix any reported syntax error, then copy or download the result.
home.private: Your JSON stays in this browser. Tool Kumar does not upload documents to a server, require an account or place ads in the editor. The app can continue working offline after it loads.
home.faq.1.a: A JSON viewer displays structured JSON in a readable format, often with a collapsible tree, search and validation.
home.faq.2.q: How do I format JSON online?
home.faq.2.a: Paste your JSON into Tool Kumar. The formatter creates an indented view, while the validator reports syntax errors.
home.faq.3.a: Yes. Parsing and formatting happen in your browser, so your document does not need to leave your device.
home.faq.4.q: Can I validate a large JSON file?
home.faq.4.a: Yes. The viewer is designed for large documents and keeps the input local while it parses the file.
